beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Dave's back for what he says is the last reading he needs — not the last time he'll stop by.

beats.prompt: The past: the point you stopped carrying it all alone.
The present: the success bright enough that other people noticed too.
The future: the whole shape of it, now that it's actually finished.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Quiz me one last time. If this is a full cycle completed, is the reading telling me to stop?"

options.text: No — completing this cycle is exactly what frees you to start the next one.
Yes, this is as far as it goes.
The World doesn't mean anything is actually finished.

elaboration: Completion here clears the way for the next beginning — the circle closing is the whole reason a new one gets to start.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "So what am I even supposed to cut away, if everything's finally working?"

options.text: Whatever's no longer needed now that you've actually landed — that's still worth clearing out.
Nothing — cutting anything away now would ruin it.
This card has nothing to do with cutting anything away.

elaboration: Closure here comes from cutting away what's no longer needed, even in a version of things that's finally working.

beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: "One thread, if you want it: the same card that opened your very first reading was the Fool — and the Fool's whole arc ends exactly here, in the World, one circle closed and another one already waiting."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "...Yeah. Guess I finally get to stop calling it a leap of faith and start calling it a business. Thanks for sticking with the version of me that didn't know that yet."
